content_requirement: Successful acquisition of the cited PDF and successful text extraction are mandatory; metadata or abstract-only matches do not qualify.
pass_rule: pass if at least one frozen pattern family matches the extracted PDF text and the matched heading/block contains at least 3 subsequent non-empty lines within the frozen lookahead window.

normalization.line_text: Unicode text from pdftotext -layout, trimmed for matching; matching is case-insensitive.
normalization.heading_line: A match must occur on a complete line after trimming leading/trailing whitespace; no substring-only sentence match qualifies.

numbered_algorithm_or_pseudocode_block.description: A complete heading line beginning with Algorithm or Pseudocode followed by an explicit number.

explicit_implementation_section.description: A complete section-heading line named Implementation or Implementation Details, optionally numbered.

appendix_trading_rules_section.description: A complete heading line explicitly named Appendix: Trading Rules, including a single appendix letter variant.

exclusions: Do not match title or abstract fields; only extracted PDF lines are eligible.
Do not match a sentence containing the words implementation, algorithm, pseudocode, or trading rules unless it satisfies a complete-line heading/block pattern.
Do not infer deterministic entry, exit, risk, sizing, costs, timing, or execution rules from a high-disclosure match.
Do not manually override a fail or add a paper because it looks promising.
Acquisition or text-extraction failure is a mechanical fail with a recorded failure reason.

sampling.method: Python random.Random with fixed seed over sorted passing document_id values
